decisions.hidden_reasoning:
The opponent has Garchomp, Rotom-Wash, Scizor, Incineroar, Gholdengo, and Ninetales-Alola. I need to pick 3 that cover their threats well.

Garchomp is a Dragon/Ground threat — my Gholdengo is immune to its STAB Earthquake (Ghost) and resists Dragon (Steel). Kingambit is also Steel/Dark, resists Dragon but takes neutral from Earthquake. Rotom-Wash is Electric/Water, resists Garchomp's Ground but is weak to Grass (not on their team) and handles Scizor decently.

Scizor is Bug/Steel — my Gholdengo is immune to Bug and resists Steel. Kingambit resists both. Rotom-Wash is neutral to both but can hit Scizor with Thunderbolt.

Incineroar is Fire/Dark — Gholdengo resists Dark, immune to Ghost but Incineroar doesn't have Ghost moves typically. Kingambit resists Dark and Fire (Steel). Rotom-Wash is weak to Fire but can hit Incineroar with Water.

Ninetales-Alola is Ice/Fairy — Gholdengo is neutral to both. Kingambit is weak to Fairy (Steel) and neutral to Ice. Rotom-Wash is neutral to both but can hit with Water.

Gholdengo is a must — it hard counters Scizor and handles Garchomp's Earthquake. Kingambit is a strong offensive core piece that resists many of their types. Rotom-Wash provides Electric coverage and can switch into Garchomp's Ground attacks.

Best trio: Gholdengo leads (handles Scizor and Garchomp), Kingambit second (offensive pressure), Rotom-Wash third (coverage and switch-in ability).
